reasons.plausibility: The proposed oxide-based wear-protection mechanism aligns well with established oxidation behavior of high-entropy alloys, though the specific role of Cu oxides might be less certain.
reasons.testability: A direct experimental comparison of pre-oxidized versus as-deposited coatings under identical high-temperature wear conditions provides a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a concrete, mechanism-based approach to improving high-temperature wear performance with a straightforward intervention and clear outcome metrics for researchers.
